ConnectionStrings.//comment: EDIT: point Server= at your SQL host and Database= at the archive DB. Integrated Security uses the IIS App Pool identity (no password stored).

Archive.//AttachmentRoot: UNC path to the attachment store when the app runs off-box; use the local F:\... path when running on the SQL host itself.

Access.//comment: AllowedGroupIds = the only groups selectable/visible in the portal. RestrictedGroupIds (RH) are visible only to users listed in dbo.FS_Portal_RH_Access.
